description:
The book: composable Monte-Carlo model step blocks (GBM, Heston, SABR, local-vol,
    Hull-White 1F, LMM), a payoff vocabulary (European / Asian / lookback / barrier / digital /
    cliquet / autocallable / FX / quanto / basket / caps-swaptions / Bermudan shell), the
    MonteCarlo and MultiOutput drivers, variance-reduction hooks, a curve bootstrap with
    analytic Jacobian, and an adjoint-gradient Calibrator (L-BFGS and Levenberg-Marquardt).
    Also carries the scenario-ladder runner, the binomial-lattice convergence check, and the
    Gaussian-copula credit / CDO-tranche pricers.
